outcomes.question: ¿Cuál fue el crecimiento porcentual de los ingresos de cada región entre enero-octubre de 2025 y enero-octubre de 2026?
sql: WITH ingresos_2025 AS (SELECT r.region_id, r.nombre AS region, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id JOIN retail.sucursales AS s ON s.sucursal_id = v.sucursal_id JOIN retail.regiones AS r ON r.region_id = s.region_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2025-11-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY r.region_id, r.nombre), ingresos_2026 AS (SELECT r.region_id, r.nombre AS region, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id JOIN retail.sucursales AS s ON s.sucursal_id = v.sucursal_id JOIN retail.regiones AS r ON r.region_id = s.region_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY r.region_id, r.nombre) SELECT i2025.region, i2025.ingresos AS ingresos_2025, i2026.ingresos AS ingresos_2026, ((i2026.ingresos - i2025.ingresos) / i2025.ingresos) * 100 AS crecimiento_porcentual FROM ingresos_2025 AS i2025 JOIN ingresos_2026 AS i2026 ON i2025.region_id = i2026.region_id ORDER BY crecimiento_porcentual DESC LIMIT 1

WITH ingresos_2025 AS (SELECT r.region_id, r.nombre AS region, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id JOIN retail.sucursales AS s ON s.sucursal_id = v.sucursal_id JOIN retail.regiones AS r ON r.region_id = s.region_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2025-11-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY r.region_id, r.nombre), ingresos_2026 AS (SELECT r.region_id, r.nombre AS region, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id JOIN retail.sucursales AS s ON s.sucursal_id = v.sucursal_id JOIN retail.regiones AS r ON r.region_id = s.region_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY r.region_id, r.nombre) SELECT i2025.region, i2025.ingresos AS ingresos_2025, i2026.ingresos AS ingresos_2026, ((i2026.ingresos - i2025.ingresos) / i2025.ingresos) * 100 AS crecimiento_porcentual FROM ingresos_2025 AS i2025 JOIN ingresos_2026 AS i2026 ON i2025.region_id = i2026.region_id ORDER BY crecimiento_porcentual DESC LIMIT 1

WITH ingresos_2025 AS (SELECT r.region_id, r.nombre AS region, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id JOIN retail.sucursales AS s ON s.sucursal_id = v.sucursal_id JOIN retail.regiones AS r ON r.region_id = s.region_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-02-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY r.region_id, r.nombre), ingresos_2026 AS (SELECT r.region_id, r.nombre AS region, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id JOIN retail.sucursales AS s ON s.sucursal_id = v.sucursal_id JOIN retail.regiones AS r ON r.region_id = s.region_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2027-02-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY r.region_id, r.nombre) SELECT i2025.region, i2025.ingresos AS ingresos_2025, i2026.ingresos AS ingresos_2026, ((i2026.ingresos - i2025.ingresos) / i2025.ingresos) * 100 AS crecimiento_porcentual FROM ingresos_2025 AS i2025 JOIN ingresos_2026 AS i2026 ON i2025.region_id = i2026.region_id ORDER BY crecimiento_porcentual DESC LIMIT 1

¿Qué sucursales tuvieron en 2025 ingresos superiores al promedio de ingresos por sucursal de ese año?
sql: WITH promedio_ingresos AS (SELECT AVG(ingresos) AS promedio FROM (SELECT SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY v.sucursal_id) AS subquery) SELECT sucursales.nombre, ingresos FROM (SELECT SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos, v.sucursal_id FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY v.sucursal_id) AS subquery JOIN retail.sucursales AS sucursales ON sucursales.sucursal_id = subquery.sucursal_id WHERE subquery.ingresos > (SELECT promedio FROM promedio_ingresos) LIMIT 1000

WITH ingresos_por_categoria AS (SELECT c.nombre AS categoria, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.categorias AS c JOIN retail.productos AS p ON p.categoria_id = c.categoria_id JOIN retail.detalle_ventas AS dv ON dv.producto_id = p.producto_id JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY c.nombre) SELECT categoria, ingresos, (ingresos / (SELECT SUM(ingresos) FROM ingresos_por_categoria) * 100) AS porcentaje FROM ingresos_por_categoria ORDER BY ingresos DESC LIMIT 1000

WITH ingresos_por_categoria AS (SELECT c.nombre AS categoria, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.categorias AS c JOIN retail.productos AS p ON p.categoria_id = c.categoria_id JOIN retail.detalle_ventas AS dv ON dv.producto_id = p.producto_id JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY c.nombre) SELECT categoria, (ingresos * 100.0 / SUM(ingresos) OVER ()) AS porcentaje FROM ingresos_por_categoria ORDER BY porcentaje DESC LIMIT 1000

sql: WITH ingresos_mensuales AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM v.fecha_venta) AS año, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM v.fecha_venta) AS mes, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.ventas AS v JOIN retail.detalle_ventas AS dv ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY año, mes) SELECT mes, SUM(ingresos) OVER (ORDER BY mes) AS ingresos_acumulados FROM ingresos_mensuales ORDER BY mes LIMIT 1000

sql: WITH ingresos_por_categoria AS (SELECT c.nombre AS categoria, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id JOIN retail.productos AS p ON p.producto_id = dv.producto_id JOIN retail.categorias AS c ON c.categoria_id = p.categoria_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY c.nombre), costos_por_categoria AS (SELECT c.nombre AS categoria, SUM(dv.cantidad * p.costo_unitario) AS costos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id JOIN retail.productos AS p ON p.producto_id = dv.producto_id JOIN retail.categorias AS c ON c.categoria_id = p.categoria_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY c.nombre) SELECT ipc.categoria, (ipc.ingresos - cpc.costos) * 100.0 / ipc.ingresos AS margen_bruto_porcentaje FROM ingresos_por_categoria AS ipc JOIN costos_por_categoria AS cpc ON ipc.categoria = cpc.categoria ORDER BY margen_bruto_porcentaje DESC LIMIT 1

outcomes.question: ¿Cuántas unidades de Útiles Escolares vendió la Costa en abril y mayo de 2026, y cuántas la Sierra en agosto y septiembre de 2026?
sql: WITH ventas_utiles_escolares AS (SELECT SUM(detalle_ventas.cantidad) AS unidades_vendidas FROM retail.detalle_ventas JOIN retail.ventas ON detalle_ventas.venta_id = ventas.venta_id JOIN retail.productos ON detalle_ventas.producto_id = productos.producto_id JOIN retail.sucursales ON ventas.sucursal_id = sucursales.sucursal_id WHERE productos.categoria_id = (SELECT categoria_id FROM retail.categorias WHERE nombre = 'Útiles Escolares') AND ventas.canal = 'tienda' AND ventas.estado = 'completada' AND sucursales.region_id = (SELECT region_id FROM retail.regiones WHERE nombre = 'Costa') AND ventas.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND ventas.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-06-01' AS DATE)) SELECT unidades_vendidas FROM ventas_utiles_escolares LIMIT 1000

WITH ventas_validas AS (SELECT dv.detalle_id, dv.cantidad FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id WHERE v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND v.estado = 'completada'), utils_escolares AS (SELECT dv.detalle_id, dv.cantidad FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.productos AS p ON dv.producto_id = p.producto_id WHERE p.categoria_id = (SELECT categoria_id FROM retail.categorias WHERE nombre = 'Útiles Escolares')), ventas_sierra AS (SELECT dv.detalle_id, dv.cantidad FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id JOIN retail.sucursales AS s ON v.sucursal_id = s.sucursal_id WHERE s.region_id = (SELECT region_id FROM retail.regiones WHERE nombre = 'Sierra')) SELECT SUM(v.cantidad) AS unidades_vendidas FROM ventas_validas AS v JOIN utils_escolares AS u ON v.detalle_id = u.detalle_id JOIN ventas_sierra AS s ON v.detalle_id = s.detalle_id LIMIT 1000

outcomes.question: ¿Qué sucursal tuvo el mayor crecimiento porcentual de ingresos del primer semestre de 2025 al primer semestre de 2026, considerando solo sucursales con ventas en ambos semestres?
sql: WITH ingresos_2025 AS (SELECT sucursal_id, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2025-07-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY sucursal_id), ingresos_2026 AS (SELECT sucursal_id, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY sucursal_id) SELECT s.sucursal_id, s.nombre, ((i2026.ingresos - i2025.ingresos) / i2025.ingresos) * 100 AS crecimiento_porcentual FROM retail.sucursales AS s JOIN ingresos_2025 AS i2025 ON s.sucursal_id = i2025.sucursal_id JOIN ingresos_2026 AS i2026 ON s.sucursal_id = i2026.sucursal_id ORDER BY crecimiento_porcentual DESC LIMIT 1

WITH ingresos_2025 AS (SELECT s.sucursal_id, s.nombre, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.sucursales AS s JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON v.sucursal_id = s.sucursal_id JOIN retail.detalle_ventas AS dv ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2025-07-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY s.sucursal_id, s.nombre) SELECT i.sucursal_id, i.nombre, i.ingresos AS ingresos_2025 FROM ingresos_2025 AS i LIMIT 1000

WITH ingresos_2026 AS (SELECT s.sucursal_id, s.nombre, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.sucursales AS s JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON v.sucursal_id = s.sucursal_id JOIN retail.detalle_ventas AS dv ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.canal = 'tienda' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY s.sucursal_id, s.nombre) SELECT s.sucursal_id, s.nombre, COALESCE(i.ingresos, 0) AS ingresos_2026 FROM retail.sucursales AS s LEFT JOIN ingresos_2026 AS i ON i.sucursal_id = s.sucursal_id LIMIT 1000

WITH ingresos_2025 AS (SELECT sucursal_id, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2025-07-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY sucursal_id), ingresos_2026 AS (SELECT sucursal_id, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY sucursal_id) SELECT s.sucursal_id, s.nombre, COALESCE((i2026.ingresos - i2025.ingresos) / i2025.ingresos * 100, 0) AS crecimiento_porcentual FROM retail.sucursales AS s LEFT JOIN ingresos_2025 AS i2025 ON s.sucursal_id = i2025.sucursal_id LEFT JOIN ingresos_2026 AS i2026 ON s.sucursal_id = i2026.sucursal_id WHERE i2025.ingresos IS NOT NULL AND i2026.ingresos IS NOT NULL ORDER BY crecimiento_porcentual DESC LIMIT 1

outcomes.question: ¿Cuáles fueron los 3 productos con más ingresos en cada región durante el último trimestre?
sql: WITH ingresos_por_producto AS (SELECT r.region_id, r.nombre AS region, p.producto_id, p.nombre AS producto, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.ventas AS v JOIN retail.detalle_ventas AS dv ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id JOIN retail.productos AS p ON dv.producto_id = p.producto_id JOIN retail.regiones AS r ON v.sucursal_id = r.region_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY r.region_id, r.nombre, p.producto_id, p.nombre) SELECT region, producto, ingresos FROM ingresos_por_producto ORDER BY region, ingresos DESC LIMIT 3

outcomes.question: ¿En qué sucursales el Smart TV LED 65" Samsung tenía stock cero al cierre de agosto de 2026?
sql: SELECT s.nombre AS nombre_sucursal FROM retail.sucursales AS s JOIN retail.inventario AS i ON s.sucursal_id = i.sucursal_id WHERE i.producto_id = (SELECT p.producto_id FROM retail.productos AS p WHERE p.nombre = 'Smart TV LED 65" Samsung') AND i.stock = 0 AND i.fecha_corte >= CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND i.fecha_corte < CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

outcomes.question: ¿Qué producto tuvo la mayor tasa de devolución (unidades devueltas sobre unidades vendidas) en las ventas completadas del tercer trimestre de 2025, entre los productos con al menos 50 unidades vendidas?
sql: WITH ventas_completadas AS (SELECT dv.producto_id, SUM(dv.cantidad) AS unidades_vendidas FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-07-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2025-10-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY dv.producto_id HAVING SUM(dv.cantidad) >= 50), devoluciones_productos AS (SELECT d.detalle_id, SUM(d.cantidad) AS unidades_devueltas FROM retail.devoluciones AS d JOIN retail.detalle_ventas AS dv ON dv.detalle_id = d.detalle_id WHERE d.fecha_devolucion >= CAST('2025-07-01' AS DATE) AND d.fecha_devolucion < CAST('2025-10-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY d.detalle_id) SELECT p.nombre AS nombre_producto, COALESCE(dp.unidades_devueltas, 0) * 1.0 / vc.unidades_vendidas AS tasa_devolucion FROM retail.productos AS p JOIN ventas_completadas AS vc ON vc.producto_id = p.producto_id LEFT JOIN devoluciones_productos AS dp ON dp.detalle_id = vc.producto_id ORDER BY tasa_devolucion DESC LIMIT 1

outcomes.question: ¿Qué días de febrero de 2025 la sucursal Cuenca El Ejido no registró ninguna venta?
sql: WITH ventas_cuenca_el_ejido AS (SELECT DISTINCT fecha_venta FROM retail.ventas AS v JOIN retail.sucursales AS s ON s.sucursal_id = v.sucursal_id WHERE s.nombre = 'Cuenca El Ejido' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-02-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2025-03-01' AS DATE)) SELECT CAST(fecha AS DATE) AS dia FROM GENERATE_SERIES(CAST('2025-02-01' AS DATE), CAST('2025-02-28' AS DATE), CAST('1 day' AS INTERVAL)) AS fecha WHERE NOT fecha IN (SELECT fecha_venta FROM ventas_cuenca_el_ejido) LIMIT 1000

outcomes.question: ¿Cuál fue la venta completada con más unidades de laptops en marzo de 2026? Dame el número de venta, el id del cliente y las unidades.
sql: WITH ventas_laptops AS (SELECT v.venta_id, v.cliente_id, SUM(dv.cantidad) AS unidades FROM retail.ventas AS v JOIN retail.detalle_ventas AS dv ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id JOIN retail.productos AS p ON dv.producto_id = p.producto_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND p.nombre LIKE '%laptop%' GROUP BY v.venta_id, v.cliente_id) SELECT venta_id, cliente_id, unidades FROM ventas_laptops ORDER BY unidades DESC LIMIT 1

outcomes.question: ¿Qué porcentaje de las ventas completadas de cada año fueron online?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM v.fecha_venta) AS año, COUNT(*) AS ventas_online FROM retail.ventas AS v WHERE v.canal = 'online' AND v.estado = 'completada' GROUP BY año ORDER BY año LIMIT 1000

outcomes.question: ¿Cuál fue el ticket promedio por segmento de cliente registrado en 2025?
sql: WITH ingresos_por_segmento AS (SELECT c.segmento, AVG(v.total) AS ticket_promedio FROM retail.ventas AS v JOIN retail.clientes AS c ON v.cliente_id = c.cliente_id JOIN retail.detalle_ventas AS dv ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND NOT dv.detalle_id IN (SELECT detalle_id FROM retail.devoluciones) GROUP BY c.segmento) SELECT segmento, ticket_promedio FROM ingresos_por_segmento ORDER BY ticket_promedio DESC LIMIT 1000

outcomes.question: ¿Qué vendedor generó más ingresos en 2025? Indica su id de empleado.
sql: WITH ingresos_vendedores AS (SELECT e.empleado_id, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.empleados AS e JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON v.empleado_id = e.empleado_id JOIN retail.detalle_ventas AS dv ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY e.empleado_id) SELECT empleado_id FROM ingresos_vendedores ORDER BY ingresos DESC LIMIT 1

outcomes.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre las ventas brutas y los ingresos de 2025?
sql: SELECT SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario) AS ventas_brutas FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) LIMIT 1000

outcomes.question: ¿Cuántos dólares de ingresos por metro cuadrado generó cada formato de sucursal en 2025?
sql: WITH ingresos_por_sucursal AS (SELECT s.sucursal_id, s.nombre, s.formato, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.sucursales AS s JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON v.sucursal_id = s.sucursal_id JOIN retail.detalle_ventas AS dv ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY s.sucursal_id, s.nombre, s.formato) SELECT formato, SUM(ingresos) AS total_ingresos FROM ingresos_por_sucursal GROUP BY formato LIMIT 1000

outcomes.question: ¿Cuántos clientes registrados hicieron más de 20 compras completadas en 2025?
sql: WITH compras_completadas AS (SELECT cliente_id FROM retail.ventas WHERE estado = 'completada' AND fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY cliente_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 20) SELECT COUNT(*) AS clientes_con_mas_de_20_compras FROM compras_completadas LIMIT 1000

outcomes.question: ¿Qué sucursales tenían más de 100 productos por debajo del stock mínimo al cierre de octubre de 2026?
sql: SELECT s.nombre AS nombre_sucursal FROM retail.sucursales AS s JOIN retail.inventario AS i ON s.sucursal_id = i.sucursal_id WHERE i.stock < i.stock_minimo AND i.fecha_corte >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND i.fecha_corte < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY s.nombre HAVING COUNT(i.producto_id) > 100 LIMIT 1000

SELECT p.producto_id, p.nombre, i.stock, i.stock_minimo FROM retail.productos AS p JOIN retail.inventario AS i ON p.producto_id = i.producto_id WHERE i.stock < i.stock_minimo AND i.fecha_corte >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND i.fecha_corte < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS productos_bajo_stock_minimo FROM retail.inventario WHERE fecha_corte >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND fecha_corte < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) AND stock < stock_minimo LIMIT 1000

WITH productos_bajo_stock AS (SELECT i.sucursal_id, COUNT(*) AS productos_bajo_stock FROM retail.inventario AS i WHERE i.stock < i.stock_minimo AND i.fecha_corte >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND i.fecha_corte < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY i.sucursal_id) SELECT s.sucursal_id, s.nombre, s.ciudad, s.provincia, ps.productos_bajo_stock FROM retail.sucursales AS s JOIN productos_bajo_stock AS ps ON s.sucursal_id = ps.sucursal_id WHERE ps.productos_bajo_stock > 100 LIMIT 1000

outcomes.question: ¿Qué categoría tuvo el mayor crecimiento porcentual de unidades vendidas del segundo trimestre de 2026 al tercer trimestre de 2026?
sql: WITH ventas_completadas AS (SELECT dv.producto_id, SUM(dv.cantidad) AS unidades_vendidas FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY dv.producto_id), unidades_por_categoria AS (SELECT p.categoria_id, SUM(vc.unidades_vendidas) AS total_unidades FROM ventas_completadas AS vc JOIN retail.productos AS p ON vc.producto_id = p.producto_id GROUP BY p.categoria_id) SELECT c.nombre AS categoria, u.total_unidades FROM unidades_por_categoria AS u JOIN retail.categorias AS c ON u.categoria_id = c.categoria_id ORDER BY u.total_unidades DESC LIMIT 1000

WITH ventas_2026 AS (SELECT c.categoria_id, c.nombre AS categoria, SUM(dv.cantidad) AS unidades_vendidas FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id JOIN retail.productos AS p ON dv.producto_id = p.producto_id JOIN retail.categorias AS c ON p.categoria_id = c.categoria_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.canal = 'tienda' AND v.metodo_pago = 'efectivo' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY c.categoria_id, c.nombre) SELECT categoria, unidades_vendidas FROM ventas_2026 ORDER BY unidades_vendidas DESC LIMIT 1

sql: WITH anuladas AS (SELECT v.sucursal_id, COUNT(v.venta_id) AS num_anuladas FROM retail.ventas AS v WHERE v.estado = 'anulada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY v.sucursal_id) SELECT s.nombre, an.num_anuladas FROM retail.sucursales AS s JOIN anuladas AS an ON s.sucursal_id = an.sucursal_id ORDER BY an.num_anuladas DESC LIMIT 1

outcomes.question: Ingresos por provincia en 2025
sql: WITH ingresos_por_provincia AS (SELECT s.provincia, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id JOIN retail.sucursales AS s ON s.sucursal_id = v.sucursal_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY s.provincia) SELECT provincia, SUM(ingresos) AS total_ingresos FROM ingresos_por_provincia GROUP BY provincia ORDER BY total_ingresos DESC LIMIT 1000

outcomes.question: Total facturado con IVA por región en lo que va del año
sql: WITH ingresos_por_region AS (SELECT r.nombre AS region, SUM(v.total) AS total_facturado FROM retail.ventas AS v JOIN retail.sucursales AS s ON s.sucursal_id = v.sucursal_id JOIN retail.regiones AS r ON r.region_id = s.region_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY r.nombre) SELECT region, total_facturado FROM ingresos_por_region ORDER BY total_facturado DESC LIMIT 1000

outcomes.question: ¿Cuántos clientes registrados distintos compraron en la sucursal Samborondón en 2025?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.cliente_id) AS clientes_distintos FROM retail.ventas AS v JOIN retail.sucursales AS s ON v.sucursal_id = s.sucursal_id WHERE s.nombre = 'Samborondón' AND v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

outcomes.question: Ingresos mensuales de la categoría Juguetes en 2025
sql: WITH ingresos_mensuales AS (SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM v.fecha_venta) AS mes, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.ventas AS v JOIN retail.detalle_ventas AS dv ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id JOIN retail.productos AS p ON p.producto_id = dv.producto_id JOIN retail.categorias AS c ON c.categoria_id = p.categoria_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND c.nombre = 'Juguetes' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY mes) SELECT mes, ingresos FROM ingresos_mensuales ORDER BY mes LIMIT 1000

outcomes.question: ¿Cuántos empleados reportan directamente al gerente de la sucursal Cuenca Centro?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cantidad_empleados FROM retail.empleados AS e JOIN retail.sucursales AS s ON e.sucursal_id = s.sucursal_id WHERE s.nombre = 'Cuenca Centro' AND e.supervisor_id IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1000

outcomes.question: ¿Cuál es la nómina mensual (suma de salarios) de cada sucursal?
sql: SELECT s.nombre AS sucursal, SUM(e.salario_mensual) AS nómina_mensual FROM retail.sucursales AS s JOIN retail.empleados AS e ON e.sucursal_id = s.sucursal_id GROUP BY s.sucursal_id, s.nombre LIMIT 1000

outcomes.question: ¿Cuántas unidades del Smart TV LED 55" Samsung se vendieron en cada sucursal el último trimestre?
sql: WITH ventas_filtradas AS (SELECT dv.producto_id, dv.cantidad, s.sucursal_id, s.nombre AS nombre_sucursal FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id JOIN retail.sucursales AS s ON v.sucursal_id = s.sucursal_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.canal = 'tienda' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE)), productos AS (SELECT producto_id FROM retail.productos WHERE nombre = 'Smart TV LED 55" Samsung') SELECT nombre_sucursal, SUM(cantidad) AS unidades_vendidas FROM ventas_filtradas JOIN productos ON ventas_filtradas.producto_id = productos.producto_id GROUP BY nombre_sucursal ORDER BY unidades_vendidas DESC LIMIT 1000

outcomes.question: ¿Cuáles fueron las 3 sucursales con más ventas online completadas en 2025?
sql: WITH ventas_online AS (SELECT v.sucursal_id, COUNT(v.venta_id) AS num_ventas FROM retail.ventas AS v WHERE v.canal = 'online' AND v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY v.sucursal_id) SELECT s.nombre, s.ciudad, s.provincia, v.num_ventas FROM retail.sucursales AS s JOIN ventas_online AS v ON s.sucursal_id = v.sucursal_id ORDER BY v.num_ventas DESC LIMIT 3

outcomes.question: ¿Cuánto vendió en ingresos cada categoría el mes pasado?
sql: WITH ingresos_por_categoria AS (SELECT c.nombre AS categoria, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.categorias AS c JOIN retail.productos AS p ON p.categoria_id = c.categoria_id JOIN retail.detalle_ventas AS dv ON dv.producto_id = p.producto_id JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY c.nombre) SELECT categoria, ingresos FROM ingresos_por_categoria ORDER BY ingresos DESC LIMIT 1000

outcomes.question: ¿Cuál fue el producto de la categoría Deportes con más ingresos en 2025?
sql: WITH ingresos_por_producto AS (SELECT p.producto_id, p.nombre, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.productos AS p JOIN retail.detalle_ventas AS dv ON dv.producto_id = p.producto_id JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY p.producto_id, p.nombre) SELECT producto_id, nombre, MAX(ingresos) AS ingresos_maximos FROM ingresos_por_producto WHERE producto_id IN (SELECT producto_id FROM retail.productos WHERE categoria_id = (SELECT categoria_id FROM retail.categorias WHERE nombre = 'Deportes')) GROUP BY producto_id, nombre LIMIT 1000

outcomes.question: ¿Cuántos clientes de cada segmento compraron al menos una vez el último trimestre?
sql: WITH ventas_ult_trimestre AS (SELECT DISTINCT cliente_id FROM retail.ventas WHERE estado = 'completada' AND fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND fecha_venta < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE)) SELECT segmento, COUNT(cliente_id) AS clientes_compraron FROM retail.clientes WHERE cliente_id IN (SELECT cliente_id FROM ventas_ult_trimestre) GROUP BY segmento LIMIT 1000

outcomes.question: ¿Cuál fue el descuento promedio por venta completada en cada canal en 2025?
sql: WITH ventas_completadas AS (SELECT v.canal, AVG(dv.descuento) AS descuento_promedio FROM retail.ventas AS v JOIN retail.detalle_ventas AS dv ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY v.canal) SELECT canal, descuento_promedio FROM ventas_completadas ORDER BY descuento_promedio DESC LIMIT 1
